newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shell Electric 1996 net down 80.12 pct.
newsitem.headline: Shell Electric 1996 net down 80.12 pct.

text.p: Company name Shell Electric Mfg (Holdings) Co Ltd
NOTE - Shell Electric is a maker of fans, telephones and microwave ovens.
Total dividend for year is 16 H.K. cents (including interim dividend of eight cents) vs same.
With effect from 1996, the group changes its policy of accounting for the results of an associated company which principal activities are property development in China.

Where previously the associated company recognised its property development profit by stage of completion, the group had made an adjustment on consolidation to reverse such profit to comply with the group's policy of recognising property development profits on a completion basis, as from this year, the group considers that it would be more appropriate to account for the results of this associated company based on its financial statements as consistent with other associated companies.
A prior year adjustment has been made to restate the group's share of results of this associated company for the previous year.
As a result of the change in accounting policy concerning the share of result in an associated company, the comparative share earnings has been re-stated accordingly.
